name: Soft Dice loss
description: Sigmoid binary or softmax multiclass Dice; averages per-sample/class scores, applies optional valid mask, and smooths numerator and denominator with positive smooth.

parameters.reduction: none, mean, or sum over sample/class Dice values

examples.title: Train U-Net segmentation with Dice
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 image=torch.rand((1,16,16),generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 mask=torch.zeros((16,16),dtype=torch.long)
 mask[4:12,4:12]=1
 return {"pixels":synth.Tensor(image),"mask":synth.Tensor(mask)}
ds=synth.Spec("dice-segmentation",generator=samples,size=16,splits={"train":0.75,"val":0.25},seed=11,root=root,monitor="none").run()
train=ds.for_recipe("segmentation",split="train")
val=ds.for_recipe("segmentation",split="val",like=train)
model=build("unet","tiny",in_channels=1,out_channels=2,features=[4,8])
trainer=Trainer(model,train,val,recipe="segmentation",recipe_config={"loss":"dice","loss_kwargs":{"mode":"multiclass"}},max_epochs=1,device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result=trainer.evaluate(val)
